title: Kazakhstan official e-Visa guidance
freshness_note: Extracted from official Kazakhstan e-Visa guidance on 2026-10-25; automated snapshot.
content: Before submitting an application, a foreign citizen must check whether an electronic visa of the Republic of Kazakhstan is available for their country of citizenship and purpose of travel. An electronic visa is issued on the basis of an invitation from the inviting party approved by the authorized government body. Entry into and exit from the Republic of Kazakhstan using an e-Visa are permitted only through border crossing points at international airports of the Republic of Kazakhstan. The permitted duration of stay and purpose of travel are determined by the conditions of the issued e-Visa.

title: Kazakhstan official foreign-citizen arrival notification guidance
freshness_note: Official page says updated 2024-08-05; automated snapshot captured 2026-10-25.
content: The Kazakhstan government information page, updated 05.08.2024, states that notification of a foreign citizen's arrival is carried out within 3 working days from arrival. It says an individual or legal entity, including a hotel representative or housing owner, can notify through the Visa and Migration Portal or gov.kz, or use the E-Qonaq app.
